rows.ARS:
Deep pink Shrub.
Registration name: LENray, LENspra, LLX 8598
rows.Origin:
Bred by Louis Lens (1924-2001) (Belgium, before 1980).
Introduced in Belgium by Lens Roses/Louis Lens N.V./Pépinières Louis Lens SA in 1980 as 'Pink Spray'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, white center. Mild fragrance. 4 to 11 petals. Average diameter 0.75". Small, single (4-8 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Once-blooming spring or summer.
rows.Habit:
Arching. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for ground cover. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage:
R. wichurana yakachinensis ×
seedling of Rosa multiflora var. adenochaeta Ohwi
